scope: Thirty 39-attempt cells across ten matched GPT-5.6 model/effort settings. Classification update to existing outcomes, not new attempts.
caveats: Published classification report, not an independent local raw-trajectory review. Underlying classification ledger remains unpublished; reported SHA-256 b9faeffe2d4db9c983eab440f52b0eb19cf9222ead0e142fd0c9dfb2a2e5faca.
Every recorded matrix attempt receives one category. Execution exceptions take precedence over grades. Five replaced pre-agent setup records stay outside the original 1170-attempt matrix denominator.
Physics failure requires calibration and parameter success, hidden-prediction failure, and a reviewed primary physical-model mistake. A calibration fit alone does not establish a physics failure.
Historical controls and runtime/CPU differences limit causal inference. These aggregate changes do not prove individual failures converted to passes.
No classification is imputed to the other 898 study attempts. Existing broader prediction-only or primary-cause categories are not pooled into this stricter outcome definition.
